value.name: engine.Unknown
value.doc: holds components whose type is not registered in this build

value.name: engine.Tags
value.doc: Tags names groups this node belongs to; scripts find them with scene.WithTag.

value.name: engine.SpriteRenderer
value.doc: Draws a texture region at the node transform.

value.name: engine.Camera2D
value.doc: Renders an orthographic view from the node transform.

value.name: engine.Camera3D
value.doc: Renders a perspective view looking down the node -Z axis.

value.name: engine.MeshRenderer
value.doc: Draws an unlit mesh at the node transform.

value.name: engine.Script
value.doc: holds the Aego Script attachments of a node

value.name: physics.Body2D
value.doc: Simulates the node as a rigid body. Colliders on the node and its children form its shape.

value.name: physics.BoxCollider2D
value.doc: Box shape in node space.

value.name: physics.CircleCollider2D
value.doc: Circle shape. Needs a uniform node scale.

value.name: physics.CapsuleCollider2D
value.doc: Capsule along the local X axis; Length is the full extent including the caps.

value.name: physics.PolygonCollider2D
value.doc: Convex polygon of 3 to 8 points.

value.name: physics.EdgeCollider2D
value.doc: Polyline for level geometry. OneSided lets bodies pass from below.

value.name: physics.DistanceJoint2D
value.doc: Keeps a distance between this body and the Target body. Length 0 uses the distance at start.

value.name: physics.RevoluteJoint2D
value.doc: Pins this body to the Target body at Anchor, with an optional limit and motor.

value.name: audio.AudioListener2D
value.doc: Hears spatial sound from its node. Without one the camera of the main output listens.

value.name: audio.AudioSource2D
value.doc: Plays a clip or an audio event from its node.

value.name: audio.AudioZone2D
value.doc: While the listener is inside Area, Bus is turned to Gain.

value.name: animation.AnimationPlayer
value.doc: Plays an animation clip on its node and the nodes below it: property tracks, sprite frames and events. Clip time, gameplay events and tracks other than the transform pose advance on fixed steps, so a replay gives the same result at any frame rate.

value.name: animation.Animator
value.doc: Plays the states of an animation controller and blends between them when its parameters change. The graph, the blends, root motion and gameplay events run on fixed steps, so replays match at any frame rate.

value.name: camera.VirtualCamera2D
value.doc: A camera pose the brain can pick. The highest priority wins; switching blends from the current view.

value.name: camera.CameraFollow2D
value.doc: Moves its virtual camera after Target, with a deadzone, damping and lookahead.

value.name: camera.CameraShake2D
value.doc: Tunes the shake of its virtual camera. Shake grows with trauma and fades over time.

value.name: camera.CameraZone2D
value.doc: While Target is inside Area, Camera gets Priority and the zone's zoom and bounds.

value.name: camera.CameraBrain2D
value.doc: Picks which output of virtual cameras drives this Camera 2D. Without it the camera shows the main output.

value.name: gameplay.Motion2D
value.doc: Moves a kinematic Body2D by casting its colliders: walking, jumping, slopes, steps and moving platforms, or free top-down movement. Call Move and Jump from a script; the controller acts on the next fixed step.

value.name: gameplay.Health
value.doc: Hit points of a node. Hitboxes, kill zones and scripts damage it; it dies once at zero until revived.

value.name: gameplay.Hurtbox2D
value.doc: Area where hitboxes damage a Health: on this node or on its nearest parent with Health.

value.name: gameplay.Hitbox2D
value.doc: Damages hurtboxes inside its area, once per target per activation, on every entry or periodically.

value.name: gameplay.Lifetime
value.doc: Removes the node after some seconds: back to its pool or destroyed.

value.name: gameplay.KillZone2D
value.doc: Kills a Health that enters the area, or respawns a node with Respawn and no Health.

value.name: gameplay.Checkpoint2D
value.doc: Sets the respawn point of a node with Respawn that enters the area.

value.name: gameplay.Respawn
value.doc: Brings the node back to its respawn point after death or Trigger. The first point is where the node starts.

value.name: gameplay.Pickup2D
value.doc: Fires Collected when a node enters the area; with Once the pickup then disappears.

value.name: gameplay.StateMachine
value.doc: Named states with Enter, Exit, Fixed and Update hooks found by name on the node's scripts: EnterRun(), ExitRun(), FixedRun(dt), UpdateRun(dt). Scripts change the state with Go.

value.name: save.Persist
value.doc: Persist saves the node's transform and enabled flag in save games.

value.name: audio.AudioEvent
value.doc: A sound to play with its variants, randomness, bus, voice limit and space.
